sidebar.name: Victória Gomes
sidebar.shortSummary: Software engineer with 4 years of industry experience, currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science. Passionate about AI, software engineering, and building practical solutions.

aboutMe.title: About me
description: I’m a full-stack software engineer with 4+ years of experience building web applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, Angular, TypeScript, and cloud-based infrastructure. I have worked across backend and frontend development, with a strong interest in scalable systems, clean architecture, and applied research. I am currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, where I focus on combining software engineering practice with research-driven problem solving.
